question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is '**roaring**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The passage describes the lion experiencing pain at the moment when the slave finds it.
 
• The present participle form **"roaring"** is used to show the continuous action of the lion expressing its pain.</li&
